verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's evidence pack shows infrastructure for AI assistants to connect to and query ClickHouse (MCP server, agent skills, vector search for embeddings) but no evidence of ClickHouse itself generating insights or suggestions natively inside the product — no built-in natural-language analytics, anomaly-detection dashboard, or automated insight feature is documented. The capability described (AI-generated insights surfaced inside the product) is a fair ask for a data platform but remains unevidenced here.
